title: Example content of Access to Care project
text: package includes 15 example data products demonstrating different ways visualize present Access Care analysis across multiple frameworks languages: "api-python" - REST API using FastAPI Python "api-r" - REST API using Plumber R "app-python" - Python Dash application "app-r" - Shiny application "connectwidgets" - Overview application listing related content "dashboard-r" - Quarto dashboard R "htmlwidgets-r" - Interactive county-level plot "pdf-r" - PDF report "pins-data" - Data file pins deployment "pins-model" - Model file pins deployment (linear regression hospital/population analysis) "plot-r" - Static ggplot2 map entire country "presentation-python" - Quarto presentation (Python) "presentation-r" - Quarto presentation (R) "report-python" - Quarto HTML document Python, Polars, Plotnine, Great Tables "report-r" - R Markdown HTML report email template wish create individual content locally, can use values create_content():
code: # Create a specific content type create_content(content = "app-r")  # Or create all content create_content(content = "all")

title: Create Access To Care example content — create_content
text: target destination directory content copied. Defaults current directory. content content copy. Can "" copy everything, specific content name. Available options include: "", "api-python", "api-r", "app-python", "app-r", "connectwidgets", "dashboard-r", "htmlwidgets-r", "pdf-r", "pins-data", "pins-model", "plot-r", "presentation-python", "presentation-r", "report-python", "report-r". force TRUE, overwrites existing folders. FALSE (default), skips existing folders. silent TRUE, suppresses console messages. Defaults FALSE. manifest TRUE (default), automatically creates manifest.json file content folder (except pins content). Set FALSE skip manifest creation.

what: Deploy content to Posit Connect — deploy_content
title: Deploy content to Posit Connect — deploy_content
text: Deploys content Posit Connect using Git-backed deployment content, direct deployment pins content. content location contains .connect file, deploys content. Otherwise, deploys subfolders manifest.json file.

title: Deploy content to Posit Connect — deploy_content
code: deploy_content(   repository = NULL,   branch = "main",   content_location = ".",   client = NULL,   skip_if_exists = TRUE )

title: Deploy content to Posit Connect — deploy_content
text: repository Git repository URL. NULL (default), automatically detects current git remote. branch Git branch deploy . Defaults "main". content_location Path folder containing content deploy. Defaults current directory. client Posit Connect client object. NULL (default), creates new connection using connectapi::connect(). skip_if_exists Skips content folder already exists. Defaults TRUE. Change FALSE need replace thumbnail update Vanity URL.

title: Deploy content to Posit Connect — deploy_content
text: content item: Checks manifest.json (skips missing non-pins content) Reads metadata.yml title vanity URL configuration Creates updates deployment Posit Connect Saves content GUID .connect file future updates Sets thumbnail thumbnail.png exists Configures vanity URL specified metadata.yml .connect file persists content GUID deployments, enabling updates existing content rather creating duplicates.
